description: Implementation of system-agnostic GPU and system information functions for ANGLE, including vendor identification, driver version parsing, and GPU system info printing.

classes.name: GPUDeviceInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a GPU device, such as vendor ID, device ID, driver info.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Contains a list of GPU devices and system-related GPU info, with methods to analyze GPU vendors and system configuration.

methods.name: VendorName
methods.description: Returns the vendor name string based on vendor ID.

methods.name: hasNVIDIAGPU
methods.description: Checks if any GPU in the system is from NVIDIA.

methods.name: hasIntelGPU
methods.description: Checks if any GPU in the system is from Intel.

methods.name: hasAMDGPU
methods.description: Checks if any GPU in the system is from AMD.

methods.name: GetDualGPUInfo
methods.description: Determines active GPU and switchable GPU status in dual-GPU systems.

methods.name: PrintSystemInfo
methods.description: Outputs detailed system GPU information to console.
